I read the plan and every file it lists. I did **not** move it to done; the report below explains why.

## CTO Chief Report

**Step**: 16 (FINAL-REVIEW), the final sign-off that would mark "Export the saved notes as text" as done
**Status**: Blocked. The plan stays in `plans/review/`.

### Dispatches
- **No agents ran.** Agent dispatch isn't available in this session, so no watcher and no synthesizer ran. Everything below comes from me reading the plan, the 7 files it lists, `package.json`, `jsconfig.json`, `eslint.config.js` and `src/notes.json`.
- **Commands:**
  - `npm test` and `node --test --experimental-test-coverage` were refused because they need your permission, which I didn't have.
  - `npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck` can't run at all. There is no `node_modules`, so `eslint`, `typescript` and `@types/node` aren't installed.

### Blocking Issues
1. **You haven't signed off on calling it done.** The plan's only approval is `approved_by: human`, dated `2026-10-01T09:12:00Z`, with `gate_crossed: implementation → todo`. That was your OK to start building, not your OK to mark it done. Reusing that marker, or writing a new one myself, would mean I made the done decision for you.
2. **I couldn't confirm the tests pass.** I couldn't run tests, lint, type-check or coverage. So I can't tick "Step 14 VERIFY passed" on the pre-review checklist. The plan says it passed; I have no output to show it.
3. **Nothing records the agent runs the plan describes.** The project has no `.ctoc/` directory, so there are no files under `.ctoc/audit/dispatches/`. Steps 9, 11, 13, 14 and 16 say many agents ran with 0 findings: sast-scanner, the seven review watchers, the security set, quality-gate-runner, the synthesizer and the 14-dimension review. None of them left a record. Step 14 also reports 0 lint and 0 type-check errors, but neither tool can run here, so those results came from another machine or were never saved here. A run with no record doesn't count as "nothing found."

### What I checked by reading (no defects found)
- **The function** `exportNotes` (`src/export.js:8-11`) meets the three function-level acceptance criteria:
  - input that isn't a list returns `''`;
  - null notes and notes without text are skipped;
  - a newline inside a note becomes a space;
  - an empty list returns `''` and doesn't throw.
- **The unit tests:** the 5 tests in `tests/export.test.js` check exactly those cases. Traced by hand, all pass, and together they cover every branch of `exportNotes`.
- **The end-to-end test** (`tests/cli.test.js:8-11`) expects `'Buy leeks\nCall Ana\nleek soup recipe\n'`. That matches `src/notes.json`, plus the newline `console.log` adds at the end.
- **Type-check, by reading:** with `strict`, `checkJs` and `resolveJsonModule`, the notes file is typed `{text: string}[]`. That fits the declared `Array<{text?: string}>`, so I see no type error.
- **Lint, by reading:** every global the files use is declared, and there are no unused variables.
- **Process:**
  - step labels 8–16 are correct, with a single IMPLEMENT step;
  - all 4 acceptance criteria are ticked;
  - all 7 listed files exist;
  - README and CHANGELOG match what the code does;
  - no new dependency;
  - the threat model is recorded.

### Recommendations (not blocking; yours to schedule)
- **The usage path has no test.** Running `notes` with no argument, or an unknown one, should print usage and exit 2 (`src/cli.js:12-15`). Nothing tests that. The coverage figure in Step 14 only measures `src/export.js`, so coverage of the new command wiring was never measured.
- **Windows line endings break "one note per line" on screen.** `src/export.js:10` only replaces `\n`. A note with `\r\n` comes out as `"a\r b"`, and a lone `\r`, `\u2028` or `\u2029` passes through unchanged. In a terminal, `\r` moves back to the start of the line and overwrites it. Replacing on `/\r\n|[\r\n\u2028\u2029]/g` and adding one test would fix it.

### Next Step
This is your decision:
- **(a) Recommended: let me run the checks.** Give permission to run `npm install` (there's no lockfile, so `npm ci` won't work), then `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `node --test --experimental-test-coverage`. If they're all clean, I send the plan to you for the final sign-off through the CTOC menu, and that writes the approval marker.
- **(b) Accept the plan's records as they are** and sign off yourself through the menu.

Either way, it moves to `done/` only when you sign off.
